It was established in 1890 as Wakamatsu Chikkō Company, and in March 2026 Aso Corporation became its parent company. Consolidated employees number 900 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.c6e4d95bf8cd3a51: The breakdown of consolidated revenue of ¥104,748 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is, by segment revenue from external customers: ¥102,853 million for the Construction Business, ¥479 million for the Real Estate Business, and ¥1,415 million for Other (ship management services). Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue, so its operations are centered in Japan. Its major customers are the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (¥21,453 million, 20.5% of consolidated revenue) and the Ministry of Defense (¥12,400 million, 11.8% of consolidated revenue), both of which are clients of the Construction Business. The number of consolidated employees is 900.
